details: Weight budgets rule: protection adds mass, mass costs mobility, and mobility is survival.

Buoyancy and ballistic mass fight each other; every kilogram of armor needs a liter of displacement.
System reliability multiplies failure rates; redundancy must be designed, not assumed.
